# Debt Service Ratio Limits

This policy sets the ratio limits.

## Ratio Limits

The maximum TDS ratio is 42 percent of gross income.

## Limits Table

| Ratio | Maximum |
|---|---|
| GDS | 35 percent |
| TDS | 42 percent |

## Qualifying Rate Link

Ratios use the qualifying rate.
